name: Tempester 1.6.4.0-a — dead code reclaimed (test)
description: 1.6.3.0 plus n°37, a test image for the coordinator (no version digit of its own: the screens still show 1.6.3.0). n°37 fills with 0xFF (erased flash) 38 runs of the official code that nothing can execute on 1.6.3.0, 9,876 bytes, each at least 64 bytes and proven dead by tools/reachability.py (no path, no pointer from a live source, no live immediate on its address; Ghidra's references agree): the C library's unused text formatter, unused compiler-library soft-float helpers, uncalled file-system API calls, a USB buffer-descriptor helper, a NOR chip-erase routine, MIDI DIN send and status-length helpers, a Panel bus byte writer, Play List and beat helpers without caller, two delay loops, the Timer 1 copies of the LFO Restart = Play loop (moved by n°17) and the old DIN NRPN parser (replaced by n°9a). Same reached code as 1.6.3.0 (tools/dead_code_reclaim.py check), every simulation of 1.6.3.0 passes on it. Behaviour unchanged; Voice, Panel and SAM unchanged.
